Covered customers CRUD/search/validation/409-on-delete/cross-agent 404 isolation, booking validation (markup unset/out_of_range, pax range, past/bad date, foreign customer, draft pkg), booking creation snapshot math (Cebu 3 pax: retail 12000, net 10500, markup 1500, bonus 900, earned 2400), BOOKING_DEBIT txn with idempotency key booking_debit:{id}, audit booking.create, no commission record, insufficient balance 400 with no debit/no booking, list status filter, ledger/transactions, admin confirm + cancel-with-refund (balance restored, ledger earned 0), agents cannot cancel, quote PDFs (both endpoints) contain retail per-pax + total and do NOT contain net/markup/bonus values, RBAC admin 403/anon 401. Frontend: customers new/edit/search/delete dialogs, delete disabled when customer has bookings, package detail Book/Quote buttons, new booking page (preselected package, only bookable packages listed, inline + customer auto-selected, traveller inputs per pax, summary totals, pax error, insufficient-balance warning disables submit, submit navigates to detail), booking detail + Customer quote download, bookings status tabs, Quote dialog download, Customer-view privacy toggle hides splits on new booking/detail/list, mobile 390px with no horizontal page overflow. All data cleaned up; balance restored to 53604 and ledger sum == balance.

minor.issue: Refund reads balance then writes with $set (read-modify-write). Now that agents debit concurrently via atomic $inc in create_agent_booking, a refund racing an agent booking can overwrite/lose the agent's debit (balance != SUM(ledger)). Use {$inc: {booking_account.balance: +total_agent_cost}} with ReturnDocument.AFTER to compute balance_after. Same pattern for commission reversal.

rca of the issue: Refund race: booking_service.change_status computes new_balance = read balance + refund and writes $set; any concurrent $inc between read and write is lost. Mitigation: switch to $inc and read balance_after from find_one_and_update.
